entities.name: Alveolar bone loss in ligature-induced periodontitis

relationships.subject: Substance P
relationships.object: Alveolar bone loss in ligature-induced periodontitis
relationships.evidence_quote: Deletion of tachykinin precursor 1 (Tac1), a gene that encodes SP, or treatment of gingiva with SP antagonist significantly reduced bone loss in ligature-induced periodontitis

relationships.subject: Substance P
relationships.evidence_quote: In comparison, the proportion of ligature-induced total CD45+ leukocytes and neutrophils were significantly reduced in Tac1 KO mice compared to WT

relationships.subject: Substance P
relationships.evidence_quote: Results showed that injections of SP alone without periodontal ligature increased the number of osteoclasts along the bone surfaces of the injected areas

relationships.subject: QWF
relationships.object: Alveolar bone loss in ligature-induced periodontitis
relationships.evidence_quote: Results showed that QWF injection significantly decreased bone loss compared to the vehicle injection, which is consistent with the effects of Tac1 KO.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.object: Alveolar bone loss in ligature-induced periodontitis
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that ligature-induced bone loss in Calca KO mice was comparable to WT, suggesting that net effects of global knockout of CGRP may not significantly impact bone resorption in periodontitis.

key_findings: Tac1 (substance P) deletion or SP antagonism reduced ligature-induced alveolar bone loss, osteoclasts, leukocyte recruitment and cytokines; Calca (CGRP) deletion had marginal effect.
Intragingival SP, but not neurokinin A, induced inflammation and osteoclast activation.
